question: Do the paired differences from R2 and the operating-point conclusions hold in a later calendar period?
cohort: 13,565 patients of [15] eligible at the 24-hour landmark: antibiotic, culture, and SOFA >= 2 by the landmark, alive and in the ICU
static inputs: 22 inputs available at the landmark; Charlson index and SOFA at onset not used; invasive ventilation, first-day SOFA and its components, minimum GCS, and vasopressor use from windows ending at or before the landmark
development: eligible patients, anchor_year_group 2008 - 2010, 2011 - 2013, 2014 - 2016; 85% for training, 15% for early stopping and Platt scaling
evaluation: eligible patients, anchor_year_group 2017 - 2019, evaluated once under this plan

tolerance.rule: difference bounded by the margin when the 90% DeLong interval lies inside +/- margin

previous plan.note: the period 2017 - 2019 was evaluated once under the first plan, with all 19,902 patients of [15] and the static inputs of [15]
